test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: A seller announced 30% discount on the marked price of a fan. If the selling price of the fan is Rs. 2,800, then the marked price of the fan was:
solution:
**Given:**

Discount = 30%

Selling price = Rs. 2800

**Concept: **

Selling price = Marked price - Discount

**Solution:**

⇒ The marked price of the fan = Selling price / (1 - Discount %)

⇒ The marked price of the fan = 2800 / (1 - 30%)

⇒ The marked price of the fan = 2800 / (7/10)

**Hence, the marked price of the fan was Rs. 4000.**
